title: Could a musician hold a day job while on the road?
summary: Allen doubts Alvin Alcorn could keep a day job while touring; Harry says only at home, and Joe suggests it was between New Orleans stays.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Man, it must have been something being on that road. Do you know what Alvin Alcorn told me once? He told me that he worked during the days when he was with Don Alcorn.
Guys could do that when they were on the, if they had a little gig somewhere you'd find a little job?
Well, not if they're playing every night. I couldn't say I can't. No, I don't know. I think he did though.
When he was, that's, that's, that's, I don't like to ask you about that. Well, I mean, it must have, it must have been. I couldn't.

every night on the road somewhere and he'd get back tired enough to go to sleep and go to work in a day. Maybe he had a job in Texas somewhere. You see?
